title.context: Savings: sheet heading for putting extra money aside this month.

note.context: Note saved on the deposit made from the 'Save more' sheet.

noAccount.context: Save more sheet when there are no accounts.

quarter.context: Save more sheet: chip label after an amount, a quarter of what's free. Lowercase.

half.context: Save more sheet: chip label, half of what's free. Lowercase.

all.context: Save more sheet: chip label, everything that's free. Lowercase.

needs.context: Save more sheet: after a goal in the list, what it needs per month. Lowercase.

safe.context: Save more sheet: label of the figure of what's still free this month. Same term as on the Add screen.

noIncome.message: No income logged or planned this month, so there’s nothing to go on: save what you know you can.
noIncome.context: Save more sheet: explanation when there's no income.

nothingFree.message: Nothing is free this month. Saving more now would come out of money that’s already needed.
nothingFree.context: Save more sheet: nothing is free.

safeHelp.message: What’s left of this month’s income after the planned savings and what’s been spent. Keep some for the rest of the month.
safeHelp.context: Save more sheet: explanation of the figure.

onto.context: Save more sheet: which account the money goes onto.

bank.message: In the bank: transfer {amount} from your everyday account to {account}. Then save it here.
bank.context: Save more sheet: what to do in the actual bank. Keep the <b> tags.

bankGoal.message: In the bank: transfer {amount} from your everyday account to {account} (title: {goal}). Then save it here.
bankGoal.context: Save more sheet: what to do in the bank, with the goal's name as the transfer title. Keep the <b> tags.

moreThanFree.message: That’s {amount} more than is free this month.
